newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-FIORENTINA IN THE MARKET FOR NEW MIDFIELDER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIORENTINA IN THE MARKET FOR NEW MIDFIELDER.

text.p: Italian cup holders Fiorentina, who have lost two of their opening four league games, are looking for an extra midfielder and Argentina Diego Simeone and Czech Radek Bejbl are top of their shopping list.

Team director Giancarlo Antognoni confirmed the club's market interest this week but refused to name names, saying: "We're looking for one more player, only one. He'll be a midfielder capable of playing in the middle or on the right flank."

Both Simeone and Bejbl are with Spanish champion Atletico Madrid, but Antognoni would not confirm media reports that club observers will travel to Prague next week to watch Bejbl play for the Czech Republic against Spain in a World Cup qualifier.
Meanwhile one of Fiorentina's most famous fans, film director Franco Zefferelli would welcome any improvement in his favourite team's fortunes.
Zefferelli, who shares all Fiorentina fan's loathing for arch rivals, Juventus, was incensed when Fiorentina were denied a penalty during their 1-0 defeat to Juventus on Sunday.
Zefferelli, whose remarks about Juve once famously led to legal proceedings against him from former Juventus President Giampiero Boniperti was left seething at the weekend.
"This is a disgrace, a scandal that damages all Italian soccer and not just Fiorentina," he said, also claiming his club were the victims of a Juventus conspiracy.
